name: GA-08
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Austin Scott running with large financial advantage
Democratic challenger Kelly Esti minimally funded ($19K raised, $1.7K on hand)
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~94%
model.rationale: Austin Scott holds a heavily Republican rural Georgia seat, has over $1.3 million on hand, and faces a challenger who has raised under $20,000. Markets price his reelection around 94%, and no polls or expert ratings suggest competitive risk.
model.watch: A surprise fundraising surge by Esti or a national Democratic wave environment could move this toward Lean R, but the seat's structural lean makes that unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Austin Scott seeks another term in this rural south Georgia district, which leans Republican by roughly fifteen points. He enters the general election with a large financial edge, holding about $1.3 million on hand, and faces no meaningful outside spending against him.

Democrat Kelly Esti has raised under $20,000 and reports less than $2,000 in cash, leaving her little capacity to communicate with voters. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Scott roughly a 94% chance of winning. The combination of district lean, incumbency, and the funding gap makes this a Safe Republican seat.
